Class AllowedScope

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.errorprone.noreflection.AllowedScope
public final class AllowedScope extends Object
A class or a package in which reflection is allowed, as a build names it, with the only categories allowed there when not all of them are.
  • com.example.ReflectionAccess - any reflection in the class, and in the classes and lambdas nested in it
  • com.example.Outer.Inner or com.example.Outer$Inner - in a nested class
  • com.example.internal.* - in any class of the package, or of a package below it
  • com.example.Handles:HANDLES+PROXY - only those categories, in the class

1.0.0
